messages:
Lina (Support): @Jorge urgent: OpalCare trial ingest hitting repeated 502s on embeddings — onboarding blocked and renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks. customer asks for ETA before next check-in.
Jorge (CSM): thanks Lina. can you paste the minimal logs and the last-success timestamp? classify severity please. i'll prep the customer comms draft.
Lina (Support): logs: ```
2024-05-07T14:12:03Z ERROR embed-ingest 502 
user=opal-742 req=9b2f1c model=redwood-embed-v2 upstream=nx-proxy
note: retries attempted x3, still 502s
```
Lina (Support): last good ingest: 2024-05-03. volume spike recorded 2024-05-07 14:00-14:20 UTC.
Ava (Enablement): I can run a 30m guided reingest session with them. recommend checklist: pause parallel bulk jobs, confirm dataset slices, run small pilot, escalate if fails.
Corey (SRE): quick scan shows model-proxy returning increased 5xx for that tenant window. I'm seeing queueing and throttle spikes. mitigation options: per-tenant concurrent-batch cap, reduce default batch size, short-circuit to smaller model variant.
OpsBot: Incident INC-20240507-OPAL created and assigned to Corey.
Jorge (CSM): classify as "onboarding-blocker" and mark renewal risk: high. Draft comms to customer: "We're investigating an ingest failure affecting your trial. We've opened a high-priority incident and will run a triage + guided reingest. ETA 24-72 hours depending on root cause. We'll propose a temporary mitigation to unblock you while we root cause." ok to send?
Lina (Support): ok from support. i'll attach repro and link to fail trace. also will add short repro script.
Ava (Enablement): send and request them to pause any concurrent bulk jobs. i'll schedule the enablement session for 10:30 PT after triage.
Corey (SRE): I'll run a staging test with reduced batch size; preliminary staging pass looks good. plan: push a conservative config change (per-tenant batch cap) for opal-742, monitor for 30m, then roll back to default if stable.
Jorge (CSM): owners: Jorge -> external comms + renewal note; Ava -> enablement + checklist; Lina -> repro script and customer coordination; Corey -> triage + mitigation.
Lina (Support): noted. i'll coordinate the change window with OpalCare and pin the support link.
OpsBot: INC-20240507-OPAL status=triage priority=high updates=1.
Corey (SRE): pushed temporary cap to production for opal-742. monitoring shows ingest success for two test files. no regressions observed so far.
Ava (Enablement): confirmed invite accepted by customer. will run reingest checklist and capture the exact steps so we can add to docs.
Jorge (CSM): sending comms to customer now. included ETA window and ask to pause bulk jobs. also copied renewal team to flag risk.
Lina (Support): customer acknowledged, booked session for tomorrow. they paused other ingest jobs per ask.
Jorge (CSM): post-triage follow-ups: 1) internal 15m sync after resolution, 2) record steps and add to onboarding playbook, 3) flag for renewal outreach if still unstable.
Corey (SRE): will prepare short postmortem and suggested config defaults for trials to avoid per-tenant surges.
Ava (Enablement): i'll upload the checklist and session notes to shared drive and post link here.
Jorge (CSM): thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source of truth. we'll update renewal cadence based on final resolution. :white_check_mark:
